texts.orig:
Quercus douglasii is added as a host based on this observation in California in [June](https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/123456789).

Observed in Contra Costa County, California in [July](https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/123456791).

This gall closely resembles that of [Andricus brunneus](https://www.gallformers.org/gall/1234); the host oak is the only reliable way to separate the two.
